name: WhatsAppChannelConfig
description:
WhatsAppChannelConfig is a WhatsApp channel's settings: the Business
 phone number it serves, the Meta app it installs through, and whether the
 agent may message first.

 Installing validates the number against the Meta Cloud API and records
 the observed facts in status.

fields.name: PhoneNumberId
fields.description:
Phone number ID of the WhatsApp Business number this channel serves,
 from Meta's WhatsApp Manager (API Setup), e.g. "106540352242922".

 This is the Cloud API's identifier for the number, not the phone
 number itself.

fields.name: AppRef
fields.description:
The ChannelApp (your own Meta app) this channel installs through.
 Required: there is no shared platform WhatsApp app.

fields.name: ProactiveMessagingEnabled
fields.description:
Whether the agent may send business-initiated (proactive) messages on
 this channel. Off by default: a channel is reply-only until its owner
 grants this.
